name: Kimahri, Valiant Guardian
oracle_text:
Vigilance
Ronso Rage — At the beginning of combat on your turn, put a +1/+1 counter on Kimahri and tap target creature an opponent controls. Then you may have Kimahri become a copy of that creature, except its name is Kimahri, Valiant Guardian and it has vigilance and this ability.
blocked_sentences: Then you may have Kimahri become a copy of that creature, except its name is Kimahri, Valiant Guardian and it has vigilance and this ability.

needs.what: copy exceptions on `become_copy` (707.9b) beyond the name: `add_keywords` ("it has vigilance") and keeping the source's own triggered ability ("and this ability", the Ronso Rage begin_combat trigger, referenced by index or as 'self ability') as part of the copiable values, for a permanent-duration in-place copy, so Kimahri keeps its trigger and vigilance after becoming the copied creature and any copy of Kimahri also has them
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `become_copy` takes only `copying`, `duration`, `except_name` and `objects`, and op_become_copy explicitly resets `copying_keywords`, `copying_remove_supertypes` and `copying_add_types` to None; `add_keywords` is honoured only on the self_enters_as_copy replacement path. Following it with `grant_keyword` / `grant_ability` (duration permanent) would be a layer-6 grant rather than a copiable value, so a copy of Kimahri would lack vigilance and Ronso Rage -- an approximation. The rest (begin_combat trigger on your turn, add_counters on self, tap a target creature an opponent controls, `may` around become_copy with `except_name` and `duration: permanent`) is expressible.
